networkPolicy.description: Opt-in ingress-only CiliumNetworkPolicy. REQUIRED when `trustedProxies` covers the pod CIDR: application-layer proxy trust does not prevent direct pod access.

allowEntities.description: Cilium entities admitted on the main Service port; the host entity permits kubelet HTTP probes.

extraIngress.description: Raw CiliumNetworkPolicy ingress rules appended verbatim.

sigrun.description: The sigrun deployment block (image-workflow spec §4): extension fleet, operator Secret refs, and deploy-time tools. Everything here is re-asserted into the config volume by the seed initContainer.

settings.description: settings.json keys the chart owns; re-asserted on every boot (shallow merge — chart keys overwritten wholesale, foreign keys survive).

extensions.description: The extension fleet: the settings.json `extensions` list plus per-slug settings seeded once. Mutually exclusive with the SIGRUN_EXTENSIONS env var (env wins — see values.yaml).

enabled.description: Install+load specs (npm specifiers, bare names, file:, git:) — sigrun core's packages contract; re-asserted every boot.

settings.description: Per-extension settings keyed by slug → config/settings/<slug>.json; seed-ONCE (the extension owns the file after first boot), so contents stay freeform by design.

secretsEnv.description: Names of EXISTING operator-managed k8s Secrets whose keys become env vars (envFrom secretRef) on the main container — SIGRUN_EXT_* and provider credentials. Secret values never belong in values files.

tools.description: Deploy-time kubectl-class tooling installed onto the data volume by an initContainer (spec §5). Renders only when enabled AND at least one package is listed.

enabled.description: Render the tools initContainer + PATH prepend.

dir.description: Install root on the /data PVC (binaries land in <dir>/bin).

packages.description: name@version specs (version = the release tag form, `v` included). Catalog: kubectl, helm, talosctl, flux, k9s.
